handoff.public_guard: Same public handoff for every human queue turn across roles, decoy turns and all private queues. Full audio mode only. Never select by private action. No additional private-action clip.

nightFalls.public_guard: Only the common public Night screen, identically for ordinary murder and Recruit-or-Die response transitions. Never a recruitment-only announcement.

gather.public_guard: Public gather screen before the elimination outcome. Never imply death, survival, protection or a role before reveal.

votingBegins.public_guard: Public discussion ends and ordinary voting opens. Not on an individual vote or choice.

finalVotingBegins.public_guard: Public Final Banishment voting begins; never announce an individual secret end/banish choice.

discussion.public_guard: Once at the public discussion start. Random atmosphere only; never a response to a player, accusation or private information.

banishAgain.public_guard: Public transition after the circle has chosen to continue, at the same existing discussion trigger.

murderFirst.public_guard: Only a publicly revealed, completed murder with a victim. Not quiet/protected nights or a private target selection. Victim role is irrelevant to text.

murderLater.public_guard: Same as murderFirst. Neutral wording works at any murder count.

quietNight.public_guard: Public night outcome has been revealed with no death and without the separately announced protected outcome.

shieldSaved.public_guard: Only after a publicly revealed shield-protection outcome. Never announce while the shield choice or target remains private.

banished.public_guard: Only after the public tally shows an actual banishment. Generic text makes no claim about the eliminated role.

tie.public_guard: Only after the public vote outcome is a tie/no banishment. Never use actual-banishment or role lines.

finalCircle.public_guard: Once when Final Circle is publicly introduced. No claim about remaining hidden roles.

finalDecision.public_guard: Public Final Circle instructions before its private ballots; no individual choice announcements.

endLeadIn.public_guard: Public results reveal only; must not itself name a winner.

loyalWin.public_guard: Only the actual publicly displayed Loyal victory at RESULTS. Not after merely catching a Deceiver.

deceiverWin.public_guard: Only the actual publicly displayed Deceiver victory at RESULTS. Never infer victory from majority or a private card/action.

seriesClosing.public_guard: After public results of the last game in the series only.

farewell.public_guard: On explicit series exit/back-to-title; not at the end of an ordinary private turn.

intro1.public_guard: Public opening before any private role screen; does not replace the rules explanation.

intro2.public_guard: Public rules explanation, retained after the selected greeting.

intro3.public_guard: Public objectives explanation, retained after the selected greeting.

gameBegins.public_guard: Public first board of each game, once; not every round.
